morphology.pattern_note: 按外语专名整体记忆，不作马来语词缀拆分。通常写作 Ramsey；所列 IPA 为常见英语读音，不代表已核定的马来语读音。数据包未提供音节与爪夷取写，保留 null。

senses.nuances: 此处将小写输入暂按专名 Ramsey 处理，不能据此认定它是 DBP 正式收录的马来语普通词。它也见于地名，原始语境不足以锁定所指。以下搭配与情景为教学示例，未经语料频率核验。姓名用法与常见读音参见 [Behind the Name：Ramsey](https://www.behindthename.com/name/ramsey)。

etymology.historical_story: Ramsey has an English place-name history behind many surname uses. A surname study connects Ramsey and Ramsay with settlements whose names refer to wild garlic and an island. Such geographical labels became family names as people were identified by their place of origin. This history does not establish the identity or ancestry of every modern bearer. [Guild of One-Name Studies：Ramsey](https://one-name.org/name_profile/ramsey/)
